trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions taken:

- **Diagnosis:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
- **Rollback:** Rolled back from v2.3.1 to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The rollback is confirmed rolled out in all three regions.
- **Incident:** Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001**, and the on-call engineer has been paged. The incident describes the v2.3.1 health check failures, the 18% error rate, and the rollback to v2.3.0.
